name: scriptdom-wasm-bridge
description: Node.js bridge for Microsoft ScriptDOM compiled to .NET WebAssembly.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/build-js.mjs
scripts.build:wasm: dotnet publish c-sharp/tokenizer -c Release && dotnet publish c-sharp/introspector -c Release && node scripts/copy-appbundle.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:introspector-projection && npm run build && node --check dist/index.mjs && node --check dist/index.cjs && node --check dist/tokenizer.mjs && node --check dist/tokenizer.cjs && node --check dist/sanitizer.mjs && node --check dist/sanitizer.cjs && node --check dist/introspector.mjs && node --check dist/introspector.cjs && node --check test/scriptdom-wasm.test.mjs && node --check test/commonjs-smoke.cjs && node --check test/typescript-consumer-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/copy-appbundle.mjs && node --check scripts/postprocess-appbundle.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-appbundle.mjs && node --check scripts/build-js.mjs && node --check scripts/clean-dist.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-introspector-projection.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-package-tarball.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/scriptdom-wasm.test.mjs && node test/commonjs-smoke.cjs && node test/typescript-consumer-smoke.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node scripts/verify-appbundle.mjs && npm run verify:package

author: Charles Anderson
